cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You've locked the shop. You can stop doing the cheerful voice for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone has to keep morale up. You're my only employee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'm off the clock. What did that empty till do to you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cried in the stockroom. Then I practised smiling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't owe me a second performance. Can we lock the stockroom and let you be upset out here?

mechanism: A corrects B's protective performance as an unnecessary technique and directs a more vulnerable interaction.
confusable: Offering generic comfort differs from actively getting B to stop performing strength or cheerful competence.
comparison: A shopkeeper performs morale for an employee; a lonely friend offers a cheerful dinner as the price of company.
seedUse: Use workplace cheer and private hosting as distinct armor, preserving B's actual need for dignity.
